name: Valkyrie
description: Valkyries are female figures in Norse mythology who serve Odin, choosing which warriors die in battle and escorting the chosen slain (einherjar) to Valhalla; their name derives from Old Norse valkyrja meaning 'chooser of the slain.'

aliases.name: Valkyrjur
aliases.meaning: Plural form: choosers of the slain

aliases.name: Wælcyrge
aliases.meaning: Old English cognate; slaughter-chooser or battle-spirit

aliases.name: Walküre
aliases.meaning: German form; most familiar through Wagner's opera Die Walküre (1870)

aliases.name: Skjaldmær
aliases.meaning: Shield-maiden; related but distinct category of mortal female warrior sometimes conflated with valkyries

origin: Norse and Germanic mythology across Scandinavia and the broader Germanic cultural sphere. Primary textual sources are Old Norse (Iceland, Norway); Old English cognates appear in Anglo-Saxon manuscripts.
